vb_textbox.text: The most important thing is to make sure you always click within the allotted time! A low score is better than no score. The gnomes are four colors--red and green, and brown and purple. The red and green will always show up together, and the brown and purple will always be together. For a set period of time, one of the gnomes in each pair will be better than the other. So, for a period it might be better to always choose the red and brown gnomes, and then this may switch and green and purple might be better. My advice is to stick with a color if you are getting more than 5 mushrooms each time. The mushroom count ranges from 0-9, so 5 is average. If a gnome returns less than 5 mushrooms then switch to the other color in the gnome pair. Good luck and you've got this!
